issues.title: unsupported claim
issues.text: Your coffee stays hot from breakfast until bedtime.
issues.reason: The description makes a specific performance claim regarding temperature retention ('stays hot from breakfast until bedtime'). The ALLOWED_FACTS do not include any data on thermal insulation, heat retention duration, or testing results. A material specification (Stainless steel) alone does not substantiate this level of performance.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the specific temperature retention claim or replace it with a general statement supported by facts, such as 'Made of stainless steel'.
